progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Eb in Reng-e Farah. The line peaks at Gk4 (383.4 Hz) at 0:13.1. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Ds4 → Eb4 → F4 → F4 → Eb4 → Eb4).
